page.overview:
Who is Flaxancible?

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother)

Cecil Stedman (indirect killer) Global Defense Agency ReAnimen (killers)

Flaxancible is an evil variant of the mainstream Invincible and a supporting antagonist in the third season of the series.

Flaxancible is one of the Invincible variants assembled by Angstrom Levy to start the Invincible War in the mainstream universe. He is the first variant to be killed off in the Invincible War, courtesy of the combined efforts of the ReAnimen and Cecil.
